text.en:
of Executive Order No. 153, series of 2002,
"Sec. 3. Support of Relevant Agencies. - The HUDCC and
the DOJ shall have the authority to call on the following
government agencies to give their full support, assistance and
cooperation in the course of the implementation of this order:
Public Attorneys' Office"
All orders, issuances, rules and regulations, or parts thereof
which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
PaR Hologram # 21125

•
DONE, in the City of Manila, this
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Three.
day of Auguet
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
